// Test data: Copyright Grafana Labs contributors.
// Adapted for Pulse on 2026-10-28; the adjacent LICENSE applies.
// Standard-library-only AST/source extraction, following logfmt-producer.go.txt.
// This never executes Loki/Pulse or computes query/parser expectations.
// From the Pulse repository root, using the unmodified pinned Loki checkout:
//
//	cp test/fixtures/logs/loki-upstream/logfmt-ownership-producer.go.txt /tmp/logfmt-ownership-producer.go
//	go build -o /tmp/logfmt-ownership-producer /tmp/logfmt-ownership-producer.go
//	/tmp/logfmt-ownership-producer /tmp/pulse-loki-expressions-reference/pkg/logql/log/parser_test.go /tmp/pulse-loki-expressions-reference/pkg/logql/internal/logqltest/testdata/parsers.logqltest > /tmp/logfmt-ownership.json
//	cmp /tmp/logfmt-ownership.json test/fixtures/logs/loki-upstream/logfmt-ownership.json
//
// Normal Elixir/Rust replay reads committed JSON, without Go or network access.
package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

const revision = "5aa4b9212d64d723f63b2770452054aa23df114d"
const parserPath = "pkg/logql/log/parser_test.go"
const enginePath = "pkg/logql/internal/logqltest/testdata/parsers.logqltest"

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
func require(ok bool, message string) {
	if !ok {
		panic(message)
	}
}
func hash(data []byte) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(data)) }
func number(s string) int     { n, err := strconv.Atoi(s); must(err); return n }
func unquote(s string) string { v, err := strconv.Unquote(s); must(err); return v }
func literal(e ast.Expr) string {
	lit, ok := e.(*ast.BasicLit)
	require(ok && lit.Kind == token.STRING, "expected string literal")
	return unquote(lit.Value)
}

type selection struct {
	Purpose     string `json:"purpose"`
	SourceStart int    `json:"source_start"`
	SourceEnd   int    `json:"source_end"`
	SHA256      string `json:"sha256"`
	Raw         string `json:"raw"`
}
type source struct {
	Path       string      `json:"path"`
	SHA256     string      `json:"sha256"`
	URL        string      `json:"url"`
	Selections []selection `json:"selections"`
}

func selectLines(data []byte, first, last int, purpose string) selection {
	lines := strings.SplitAfter(string(data), "\n")
	require(first > 0 && last >= first && last <= len(lines), "invalid source range")
	raw := strings.Join(lines[first-1:last], "")
	return selection{purpose, first, last, hash([]byte(raw)), raw}
}
func loadSource(path, upstream, expectedHash string) ([]byte, source) {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	must(err)
	require(hash(data) == expectedHash, "unrecognized source bytes: "+upstream)
	return data, source{Path: upstream, SHA256: hash(data), URL: "https://github.com/grafana/loki/blob/" + revision + "/" + upstream}
}
func labels(e ast.Expr) map[string]string {
	call := e.(*ast.CallExpr)
	selector := call.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr)
	require(selector.X.(*ast.Ident).Name == "labels", "unexpected labels package")
	out := map[string]string{}
	if selector.Sel.Name == "EmptyLabels" {
		require(len(call.Args) == 0, "unexpected EmptyLabels arguments")
		return out
	}
	require(selector.Sel.Name == "FromStrings" && len(call.Args)%2 == 0, "unsupported labels expression")
	for i := 0; i < len(call.Args); i += 2 {
		key := literal(call.Args[i])
		_, exists := out[key]
		require(!exists, "duplicate label")
		out[key] = literal(call.Args[i+1])
	}
	return out
}
func metadata(e ast.Expr) map[string]string {
	out := map[string]string{}
	for _, field := range e.(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts {
		pair := field.(*ast.KeyValueExpr)
		key := literal(pair.Key)
		_, exists := out[key]
		require(!exists, "duplicate metadata")
		out[key] = literal(pair.Value)
	}
	return out
}
func extractTables(data []byte) []map[string]any {
	fset := token.NewFileSet()
	f, err := parser.ParseFile(fset, parserPath, data, 0)
	must(err)
	raw := func(n ast.Node) string {
		return string(data[fset.Position(n.Pos()).Offset:fset.Position(n.End()).Offset])
	}
	rows := []map[string]any{}
	for _, decl := range f.Decls {
		fn, ok := decl.(*ast.FuncDecl)
		if !ok || (fn.Name.Name != "TestLogfmtParser_parse" && fn.Name.Name != "TestLogfmtExpressionParser") {
			continue
		}
		isParse := fn.Name.Name == "TestLogfmtParser_parse"
		var table *ast.CompositeLit
		var testLine ast.Expr
		for _, statement := range fn.Body.List {
			assign, ok := statement.(*ast.AssignStmt)
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			switch assign.Lhs[0].(*ast.Ident).Name {
			case "tests":
				table = assign.Rhs[0].(*ast.CompositeLit)
			case "testLine":
				testLine = assign.Rhs[0]
			}
		}
		require(table != nil && ((isParse && len(table.Elts) == 20) || (!isParse && len(table.Elts) == 10)), "unexpected table size")
		item := table.Elts[len(table.Elts)-1].(*ast.CompositeLit)
		first, last := fset.Position(item.Pos()).Line, fset.Position(item.End()).Line
		require((isParse && first == 1418 && last == 1429) || (!isParse && first == 1728 && last == 1739), "unexpected ownership row range")
		s := selectLines(data, first, last, "complete ownership table row")
		row := map[string]any{"name": literal(item.Elts[0]), "function": fn.Name.Name, "source_start": first, "source_end": last, "raw": s.Raw, "sha256": s.SHA256, "line_expression": raw(item.Elts[1]), "initial_parsed_labels": map[string]string{}, "keep_empty": false}
		if isParse {
			require(len(item.Elts) == 7 && row["name"] == "duplicate conflict with structured metadata", "unexpected parse row")
			call := item.Elts[1].(*ast.CallExpr)
			require(raw(call.Fun) == "[]byte" && len(call.Args) == 1, "unexpected line conversion")
			row["line"] = literal(call.Args[0])
			row["base_labels"], row["want"], row["want_strict"] = labels(item.Elts[2]), labels(item.Elts[3]), labels(item.Elts[4])
			row["hint_expression"], row["structured_metadata"] = raw(item.Elts[5]), metadata(item.Elts[6])
			row["effective_strict_want"] = row["want"]
			if len(row["want_strict"].(map[string]string)) > 0 {
				row["effective_strict_want"] = row["want_strict"]
			}
			row["strict_values"] = []bool{false, true}
		} else {
			require(len(item.Elts) == 6 && row["name"] == "structured metadata conflict" && raw(item.Elts[1]) == "testLine", "unexpected expression row")
			call := testLine.(*ast.CallExpr)
			require(raw(call.Fun) == "[]byte" && len(call.Args) == 1, "unexpected testLine definition")
			row["line"], row["line_definition"] = literal(call.Args[0]), raw(testLine)
			fields := [][2]string{}
			for _, expression := range item.Elts[2].(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts {
				call := expression.(*ast.CallExpr)
				require(raw(call.Fun) == "NewLabelExtractionExpr" && len(call.Args) == 2, "unexpected extraction expression")
				fields = append(fields, [2]string{literal(call.Args[0]), literal(call.Args[1])})
			}
			row["fields"], row["fields_expression"] = fields, raw(item.Elts[2])
			row["base_labels"], row["want"], row["structured_metadata"] = labels(item.Elts[3]), labels(item.Elts[4]), metadata(item.Elts[5])
			row["strict_values"] = []bool{false}
		}
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	require(len(rows) == 2, "missing ownership table rows")
	return rows
}

type load struct {
	Labels   map[string]string `json:"labels"`
	Line     string            `json:"line"`
	Start    int               `json:"start"`
	Every    int               `json:"every"`
	Count    int               `json:"count"`
	Metadata map[string]string `json:"metadata"`
	selection
}
type series struct {
	Labels map[string]string `json:"labels"`
	Values []string          `json:"values"`
}
type entry struct {
	Labels    map[string]string `json:"labels"`
	Line      string            `json:"line"`
	Timestamp int               `json:"timestamp"`
	Metadata  map[string]string `json:"metadata"`
	Parsed    map[string]string `json:"parsed"`
	selection
}
type engineCase struct {
	Query           string   `json:"query"`
	Mode            string   `json:"mode"`
	Start           int      `json:"start"`
	End             int      `json:"end"`
	Step            int      `json:"step"`
	Direction       string   `json:"direction,omitempty"`
	Outcome         string   `json:"outcome"`
	Expected        []series `json:"expected"`
	ExpectedEntries []entry  `json:"expected_entries"`
	selection
}
type fixture struct {
	SourceStart int          `json:"source_start"`
	SourceEnd   int          `json:"source_end"`
	Loads       []load       `json:"loads"`
	Cases       []engineCase `json:"cases"`
}

var goString = "(?:\"(?:[^\"\\\\]|\\\\.)*\"|`[^`]*`)"
var labelPair = regexp.MustCompile(`^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=(` + goString + `)`)

func labelText(text string) map[string]string {
	out := map[string]string{}
	for text = strings.TrimSpace(text); text != ""; text = strings.TrimSpace(text) {
		m := labelPair.FindStringSubmatch(text)
		require(m != nil, "unexpected label text: "+text)
		_, exists := out[m[1]]
		require(!exists, "duplicate label text")
		out[m[1]] = unquote(m[2])
		text = strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(text[len(m[0]):], ","))
	}
	return out
}
func extractEngine(data []byte) []fixture {
	lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
	loadRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^\{([^}]*)\}\s+(` + goString + `)\s+@ (\d+)s(?: \[repeat every (\d+)s for (\d+)\])?(?: \[metadata (.*)\])?$`)
	instantRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^eval instant at (\d+)s (.+)$`)
	rangeRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^eval range from (\d+)s to (\d+)s step (\d+)s (.+)$`)
	selectRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^eval select from (\d+)(?:s)? to (\d+)s (forward|backward) (.+)$`)
	resultRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^\{([^}]*)\}\s+([\d_ ]+)$`)
	entryRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^\{([^}]*)\}\s+(` + goString + `) @ (\d+)s(?: \[metadata (.*?)\])?(?: \[parsed (.*?)\])?$`)
	fixtures := []fixture{}
	var current *fixture
	var evaluation *engineCase
	finishCase := func() {
		if evaluation == nil {
			return
		}
		if evaluation.Mode == "select" {
			require(len(evaluation.ExpectedEntries) > 0 && len(evaluation.Expected) == 0, "missing select expectation")
		} else {
			require(len(evaluation.Expected) > 0 && len(evaluation.ExpectedEntries) == 0, "missing metric expectation")
		}
		evaluation.selection = selectLines(data, evaluation.SourceStart, evaluation.SourceEnd, "complete evaluation and exact oracle")
		current.Cases = append(current.Cases, *evaluation)
		current.SourceEnd = evaluation.SourceEnd
		evaluation = nil
	}
	finishFixture := func() {
		finishCase()
		if current != nil {
			require(len(current.Loads) > 0 && len(current.Cases) > 0, "incomplete fixture")
			fixtures = append(fixtures, *current)
			current = nil
		}
	}
	// Complete omitted block only. Never inherit loads from neighboring ranges.
	for lineNo := 34; lineNo <= 83; lineNo++ {
		text := strings.TrimSpace(lines[lineNo-1])
		if text == "" || strings.HasPrefix(text, "#") {
			continue
		}
		switch {
		case text == "clear":
			finishFixture()
			current = &fixture{SourceStart: lineNo}
		case text == "load":
			require(current != nil && len(current.Loads) == 0, "unexpected load directive")
		case strings.HasPrefix(text, "eval "):
			finishCase()
			require(current != nil && len(current.Loads) > 0, "evaluation without loads")
			evaluation = &engineCase{Expected: []series{}, ExpectedEntries: []entry{}, selection: selection{SourceStart: lineNo, SourceEnd: lineNo}}
			text = strings.TrimSpace(strings.Split(text, " #")[0])
			if m := instantRE.FindStringSubmatch(text); m != nil {
				evaluation.Mode, evaluation.Outcome, evaluation.Start, evaluation.End, evaluation.Query = "instant", "series", number(m[1]), number(m[1]), m[2]
			} else if m := rangeRE.FindStringSubmatch(text); m != nil {
				evaluation.Mode, evaluation.Outcome, evaluation.Start, evaluation.End, evaluation.Step, evaluation.Query = "range", "series", number(m[1]), number(m[2]), number(m[3]), m[4]
			} else if m := selectRE.FindStringSubmatch(text); m != nil {
				evaluation.Mode, evaluation.Outcome, evaluation.Start, evaluation.End, evaluation.Direction, evaluation.Query = "select", "entries", number(m[1]), number(m[2]), m[3], m[4]
			} else {
				panic("unexpected evaluation: " + text)
			}
		case evaluation != nil:
			evaluation.SourceEnd = lineNo
			if evaluation.Mode == "select" {
				m := entryRE.FindStringSubmatch(text)
				require(m != nil, "unexpected categorized expectation: "+text)
				evaluation.ExpectedEntries = append(evaluation.ExpectedEntries, entry{labelText(m[1]), unquote(m[2]), number(m[3]), labelText(m[4]), labelText(m[5]), selectLines(data, lineNo, lineNo, "categorized select oracle")})
			} else {
				m := resultRE.FindStringSubmatch(text)
				require(m != nil, "unexpected metric oracle: "+text)
				evaluation.Expected = append(evaluation.Expected, series{labelText(m[1]), strings.Fields(m[2])})
			}
		default:
			require(current != nil, "load without clear")
			m := loadRE.FindStringSubmatch(text)
			require(m != nil, "unexpected load: "+text)
			row := load{Labels: labelText(m[1]), Line: unquote(m[2]), Start: number(m[3]), Count: 1, Metadata: labelText(m[6]), selection: selectLines(data, lineNo, lineNo, "complete load row")}
			if m[4] != "" {
				row.Every, row.Count = number(m[4]), number(m[5])
			}
			current.Loads = append(current.Loads, row)
		}
	}
	finishFixture()
	return fixtures
}

func main() {
	require(len(os.Args) == 3, "usage: logfmt-ownership-producer parser_test.go parsers.logqltest")
	parserData, parserSource := loadSource(os.Args[1], parserPath, "346b91ced2d38e51d8cf7fd8acb3335ea5796e9286fd901b45dd625c0b3634ff")
	engineData, engineSource := loadSource(os.Args[2], enginePath, "07d63941842085ca40bbc3944884377e802df38ede67027b9702594e840114ea")
	parserSource.Selections = []selection{
		selectLines(parserData, 1181, 1190, "parse table schema"),
		selectLines(parserData, 1418, 1429, "complete structured-metadata conflict parse row"),
		selectLines(parserData, 1432, 1468, "non-strict and strict parse harnesses; metadata and effective strict oracle"),
		selectLines(parserData, 1611, 1621, "expression shared input and table schema"),
		selectLines(parserData, 1728, 1739, "complete structured-metadata conflict expression row (not 1744-1757)"),
		selectLines(parserData, 1741, 1757, "expression harness: strict=false, metadata before parsing, flat label assertion"),
	}
	engineSource.Selections = []selection{selectLines(engineData, 34, 83, "complete omitted ownership block, including all comments and whitespace")}
	rows, fixtures := extractTables(parserData), extractEngine(engineData)
	counts := map[string]int{"parse_rows": 1, "expression_rows": 1, "table_rows": len(rows), "table_evaluations": 3, "engine_fixtures": len(fixtures), "engine_sparse_slots": 0}
	for _, fixture := range fixtures {
		counts["engine_load_rows"] += len(fixture.Loads)
		for _, load := range fixture.Loads {
			counts["engine_loaded_entries"] += load.Count
		}
		for _, row := range fixture.Cases {
			counts["engine_evaluations"]++
			counts["engine_"+row.Mode+"_evaluations"]++
			counts["engine_expected_series"] += len(row.Expected)
			counts["engine_expected_entries"] += len(row.ExpectedEntries)
			for _, series := range row.Expected {
				for _, value := range series.Values {
					if value == "_" {
						counts["engine_sparse_slots"]++
					} else {
						counts["engine_numeric_slots"]++
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	counts["total_evaluations"] = counts["table_evaluations"] + counts["engine_evaluations"]
	for key, want := range map[string]int{"engine_fixtures": 3, "engine_load_rows": 6, "engine_loaded_entries": 16, "engine_evaluations": 10, "engine_instant_evaluations": 5, "engine_range_evaluations": 2, "engine_select_evaluations": 3, "engine_expected_series": 10, "engine_expected_entries": 3, "engine_numeric_slots": 13, "engine_sparse_slots": 0, "total_evaluations": 13} {
		require(counts[key] == want, "incorrect count: "+key)
	}
	artifact := map[string]any{
		"schema_version": 1, "revision": revision, "license": "AGPL-3.0-only",
		"attribution": "Grafana Labs contributors; extraction adapted for Pulse on 2026-10-28. See adjacent LICENSE. No upstream runtime implementation is included.",
		"provenance":  map[string]any{"repository": "https://github.com/grafana/loki", "producer": "test/fixtures/logs/loki-upstream/logfmt-ownership-producer.go.txt", "method": "Standard-library Go AST plus bounded logqltest source extraction, following logfmt-producer.go.txt; no runtime evaluation.", "sources": []source{parserSource, engineSource}, "range_hash_convention": "SHA-256 of exact inclusive complete source lines, including the final newline. All raw fields preserve indentation, comments and spelling."},
		"replay": map[string]any{
			"requirements": "Normal replay reads committed JSON using Elixir/Rust only, without Go, network or expectation generation. The producer is an optional provenance tool, not a test dependency.",
			"table":        "base_labels is the initial stream owner, structured_metadata is attached by the harness before parsing, initial_parsed_labels={} records the absence of preexisting parsed labels after builder reset. want is the exact flat LabelsResult().Labels() assertion, NOT a categorized output oracle. Do not infer upstream owner assertions from flat labels. keep_empty=false follows the parse harness and is inapplicable to explicit expression extraction.",
			"strict":       "Run the parse row with strict_values=[false,true]. Non-strict uses want; strict uses effective_strict_want, selecting nonempty want_strict or falling back to want (parser_test.go:1460-1464). Run the expression row only with strict=false, as asserted by its harness at 1743. Do not invent a strict expression evaluation.",
			"fields":       "Expression fields are ordered [destination, source-expression] pairs; fields_expression and line_definition preserve original Go text. line_expression=testLine is resolved from the exact shared declaration at parser_test.go:1612. Parse-all has no fields column. hint_expression is inert Go source, not evaluated; the selected parse row uses NoParserHints().",
			"engine":       "All exported times, steps and repeat intervals are integer seconds relative to upstream epoch 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z (logqltest/parser.go:19-25). Replay may shift the entire fixture to a deterministic retained epoch, preserving every relative timestamp. A repeat count includes the first entry; expand start+i*every for i=0..count-1 (parser.go:129-134). Preserve load order, noise and metadata; never flatten metadata into stream labels.",
			"metrics":      "mode=instant has equal start/end and step=0; mode=range has its explicit step. outcome=series uses expected label maps and original numeric-string values (or sparse underscores); evaluate at start+i*step. Labels are the exact combined metric oracle, not category assertions. Preserve all per-fixture loads across its evaluations, resetting only on clear.",
			"select":       "mode=select uses explicit direction, start/end and step=0. outcome=entries uses expected_entries: labels is the stream owner only; metadata and parsed are separate per-entry owners. Omitted category clauses become empty maps, not unknown data. timestamp and line are exact source expectations. Match all categories, text and time, not just flattened labels, following logqltest/runner.go:490-545 (categorize-labels encoding). Empty expected/expected_entries arrays are mode placeholders, NOT expect-empty assertions.",
		},
		"limitations": []string{
			"These are frozen upstream table/engine fixtures, not results of actual Loki or Pulse runtime execution. Counts describe selected upstream evaluations, not passing Pulse tests or HTTP/Parquet/S3 acceptance.",
			"Only parsers.logqltest:34-83 and the two selected parser_test.go rows are exported for replay. Neighboring sources are preserved solely as schema/input/harness provenance. This does not establish general repeated-parser ownership, hints, client/deployment/capacity or full parser compatibility, and invents no repeated-parser example.",
			"The analogous expression row is actually parser_test.go:1728-1739 at this pin; 1744-1757 is its harness. Table assertions are flat labels; only the three select evaluations provide categorized output oracles.",
			"Existing logfmt.json (60 evaluations) and logfmt-expressions.json (15 rows) are separate, unchanged selections. No production changes or HTTP replay are included here.",
		},
		"counts": counts, "table_cases": rows, "fixtures": fixtures,
	}
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
	enc.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	must(enc.Encode(artifact))
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "2 table rows / 3 table evaluations; 3 engine fixtures / 6 loads / 16 entries / 10 evaluations (7 metric, 3 select); 13 evaluations total")
}
